subject: Link to an existing html file

messages.author: bf0323012d377562
messages.subject: Link to an existing html file
parts: How do I put a link in my application to an existing html file.  I have an html file with help and explanatory text. I'd like to place a link in my app to that help text.  Is there a way to do that?  I don't see anything strictly applicable in the tutorial.  Thanks.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Link to an existing html file
parts:
Yes, you can do this:

a(href="helpfile.html", "Click here for help")

to create a link, and put helpfile.html in a directory called "www" in your app directory. Note that a number of other HTML tags such as div, h1-6, img, are exposed this way, and all other tags are available by calling tags$tagname; for example, tags$table(class="data", tags$tr(tags$td(...))) and so on.
